title: Burning Rangers (Demo)
native_title: バーニング・レンジャー
overview:
In the near future, fire is one of the few great dangers left, and the Burning Rangers are the elite rescue squad sent into the worst of it. Their mission: save lives, protect the future and keep hope alive.

Burning Rangers is a 3D firefighting action game. As rookie Ranger Shou or Tillis, jet-pack through blazing buildings and space stations, put out fires and collect the energy crystals they leave behind to beam trapped survivors to safety. With no map to rely on, you follow voice directions from navigator Chris, dodge explosions and hostile robots, and face a boss at the end of each stage.

This disc is a demo version of the game.

- 1 player
- Voice navigation guides you through each mission
- Jet pack boosts, rolls and somersaults
- 3D Control Pad support
